from pathlib import Path
import os, tempfile
p = Path('pipeline/workflow.go')
s = p.read_text()
renames = {
'LoadInput': 'ReadRequest', 'CheckInput': 'ValidateRequest',
'NormalizeValue': 'CanonicalizeValue', 'MapFields': 'ProjectFields',
'RouteValue': 'DispatchValue', 'StampEvent': 'AnnotateEvent',
'CountItems': 'TallyItems', 'MergeParts': 'CombineParts',
'FilterNoise': 'PruneNoise', 'SortRecords': 'OrderRecords',
'EncodePayload': 'MarshalPayload', 'DecodeReply': 'ParseReply',
'OpenChannel': 'ConnectChannel', 'CloseChannel': 'ReleaseChannel',
'FlushBuffer': 'DrainBuffer', 'SaveResult': 'PersistResult',
}
for old, new in renames.items():
    s = s.replace(old, new)
fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=p.parent, prefix='.workflow.go.')
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as f:
        f.write(s)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, p)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(tmp):
        os.unlink(tmp)
PY
go test ./..."
